prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: an original high-resolution painting-technique preset named 花霞の透明アニメ, one finished illustration, no text.
Create an independently designed adult woman with a warm chestnut chin-length bob, straight brows, a long narrow face, and an ivory high-neck linen tunic with a pale sage wrap skirt, standing quietly in a light-filled stone-and-timber conservatory used as a weaving workshop. She holds a simple folded linen textile with both hands. A loom, a translucent skylight, and layered distant trees make one physically connected calm space. Waist-up to knees composition, 3/4 view, leave breathing room, hands visible naturally.
Build the face, eyelids, visible iris layers, hair bundles, hands, textile, wood, stone and background from the same Japanese 2D anime drawing process: very fine pale colored lines, transparent watercolor-like glazing with separately visible overlapping pigment layers, elegant controlled lost-and-found edges. Preserve a few decisive contact shadows beneath the jaw, between the fingers and at textile folds; do not wash every plane into blank white. Soft daylight passes through the skylight, pale mint and warm apricot light gently crosses the face and sleeve. Thin textile, matte wood, chalk stone and skylight glass remain different materials. Airy clear illumination, a soft backlit rim, precise thin contours at the face and hands, quiet pigment granulation, more detail at the subject and simpler distant layers.
This is translucent PAINT AND AIR, not a transparent glass body or outfit. All human anatomy, clothing folds and joints are drawn rather than photographed. No photographic skin, no smooth plastic 3D render, no petals, bouquets, flower hair decorations, animals, ornate crowns, lanterns, magical rings, Halloween objects, glitter wall, signature, captions or watermark. Do not imitate any real artist, existing artwork or earlier sample.

observations: 細い淡色輪郭と透明な水彩状の重ね色が顔・手・布・木・石へ続く。
対象修正後の顔は描いた眼瞼、整理した鼻口と頬の色面、髪の束で2Dアニメへ統一。
顎・指・布の接点に短い影が残り、全面の白飛びではない。
独自の成人女性と織工房。花・ランタン・他作品の人物や構図を使わない。
